answer: Sybil Island employs social graph density thresholds. Each new identity must maintain minimum connection strength to the kernel within 30 days or be quarantined. Attackers face exponential cost growth: the nth sybil requires 2n+1 false relationships, each demanding real economic activity. Onyx nodes randomly verify connections through transaction cross-checks, making fake relationship farming prohibitively expensive. The mechanism enforces that identities without genuine network integration cannot participate in value flows.
